title: What happened to the 295 earlier before-filing matches?
question: How many potential matches survived a check of reinstatement, dates and permit inspections?
finding: 245 pairs had a documented license reissue between the prior revocation and local filing. This before-filing group contributed 4 trade permits at three properties. The other 46 need dated status or renewal records.
how: Review each initial match once. Join the state’s later license details to the date of the City filing. Check superseding decisions and compare applications, contractors and inspections for the reviewed case.
limits: A reissue can resolve a match to a specific earlier event. Other events or exemptions can affect eligibility. Results are grouped by outcome, permit type and issue year; one license can occur on many permits.
